subject: [RFC PATCH 21/57] mm/collapse: settle whatever the round reached

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch completes the last pass of a round in the collapse function, handling candidates that never froze and releasing resources held by refused candidates. It records the result for candidates that were selected but not frozen, and releases folios and tables allocated to candidates that were not installed. The patch also updates the count of installed candidates and returns this value.
